Abbreviations used in the report: N.C. = normal condition; S.F.C. = single fault condition; MOOP = means of Operator protection; MOPP = means of Patient protection. Throughout this report a comma/point is used as the decimal separator.

The tests results presented in this report relate only to the object tested. This report shall not be reproduced except in full without the written approval of the testing laboratory. Required markings include: rated supply voltage(s) or rated voltage range(s) with hyphen between min and max (V, V-V); multiple rated voltages separated by slash (V/V); nature of supply (phases, type of current); symbols 1-5 of Table D.1 (IEC 60417-5032, 5032-1, 5032-2, 5031, 5033, 2002-10); rated supply frequency or rated frequency range in Hz; Symbol 9 of Table D.1 (IEC 60417-5172, 2003-02) for CLASS II ME EQUIPMENT.

Clause 7.2.7 specifies RATED input marking requirements: input in amps or volt-amps (A, VA); in watts when power factor exceeds 0.9 (A, VA, W); for voltage ranges greater than ±10% of mean, rated input provided for upper and lower limits; when range limits do not differ by more than 10% from mean value, input at mean value of range is marked; marking includes long-time and most relevant momentary volt-ampere ratings, each plainly identified in ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTS; marked input of ME EQUIPMENT provided with means for connection of supply conductors of other electrical equipment includes rated and marked output of such means.

8.5.1.1：ME设备应提供两种保护手段，防止应用部分和其他可接触部分超过8.4规定的限值。保护应用部分或按4.6条识别为须满足相同要求的部件的保护手段，应视为患者保护手段（MOPP）。每种保护手段应按照第4.6条及图A.12的流程，归类为患者保护手段（MOPP）或操作者保护手段（MOOP）。涂漆、搪瓷、氧化及类似防护涂层，以及在运行和灭菌预期温度下会重新增塑的密封化合物，不应视为保护手段。构成保护手段的组件和布线应符合8.10条。不符合8.5.1.2和8.5.1.3的绝缘、爬电距离、电气间隙、组件或接地连接不视为保护手段，此类部件的失效应视为正常状态。
关于Y型电容的使用规定：符合IEC 60384-14的Y1或Y2电容可视为一种患者保护手段（MOPP）；当工作电压低于42.4V峰值交流或60V直流时，单个Y1电容可用作两种MOPP。两个串联电容使用时，每个均须按整对两端总工作电压额定，且应具有相同标称电容值。本产品（PT9L）无Y1电容及Y2电容，相关条款均判定为N/A。
关于光耦合器的规定：符合IEC 60747-5-5:2007或更新版本的光耦合器，可视为等效满足8.8.2和8.9.3的要求。需进行外部空气间隙和爬电距离测量，以及光耦合器介电强度测试。本产品相关条款判定为N/A。
